positives: Overall inspector was good and helpful

Sample locker retention time and random samples

tips: Keep poop deck free of soot and oil stains, inspector is very particular about cleanliness
Ensure emergency generator fuel injection line connection is covered with anti-splash tape
Be ready to show sample retention times and random samples
Have all records for purging, gas freeing, pressure testing and calibration readily available
summary: Inspector Capt. Chong Yongok arrived sharply at 08:30 and started the tablet at the gangway. He followed a planned schedule: deck first, then engine room, bridge and documents. He was serious about SIRE 2.0, recorded responses in the tablet on the spot and asked all questions in depth. He was particular about deck cleanliness, especially poop deck soot, and checked many records and equipment in detail. One observation was raised for the emergency generator fuel injection line connection not covered with anti-splash tape, which was rectified on the spot. Overall he was good and helpful but very sincere about the inspection.
